title: Appliance Rebates in Guelph 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Guelph appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings, with Alectra Utilities as distributor.
lead: Guelph has 56,480 households, 34% of them renting. The appliance page says nothing about owners only or home type.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Guelph
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: With 34% of Guelph households renting, tenants may ask whether they can claim. The page asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid and an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. It does not say owners only. A tenant buying their own washer, for example, has to decide whether it stays when they leave.

Alectra Utilities supplies power and Guelph postal codes begin with N, which the Energy Affordability Program lists. The program can provide energy-efficient fridges and freezers to households under the income limits.

The six rebates are $200 for a heat pump dryer, $150 for an induction cooktop or range, $75 for a washer, $50 each for a fridge and a freezer and $25 for a dishwasher. A household that replaced all six would receive $550, though few Guelph homes will need to swap everything at once. The rebate is flat, so it takes the same amount off an entry model and a premium one.
Most Efficient, not just ENERGY STAR

The rebate is for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient models, which the page describes as going beyond standard ENERGY STAR requirements. A fridge with the ordinary ENERGY STAR mark may not qualify. Each appliance has its own product list linked from the program page, so find the model number there before you pay, whether you buy in Guelph or online.

About 44% of Guelph's 56,480 households live in homes built before 1981. Age of the house tells you little about the age of the fridge, and a working appliance rarely pays back a swap through a $25 to $200 rebate alone. The rebate suits a replacement you already need to make.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a Guelph condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 34% of Guelph households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Does Alectra give an appliance rebate in Guelph?
If they are residential customers on the grid and replace an existing electric appliance, the page does not exclude them.
Is the induction rebate for a range or a cooktop?
A level above standard ENERGY STAR, as the page describes it.
